description:
[narrowed from the-semantic-gate-structurally-disfavours-information-availability-fixes] MEASURED 2026-09-12 over 260 compose reports in 24h. Edit repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/feature-compose.ts. SECOND INSTANCE 2026-09-12, which takes this from n=1 to n=2 and sharpens the class. Dispatch 90a38c01-1087-4726-a9a8-df1fe9793f4a, 3 edits in one file, refused 2/2 at confidence 0.90 and 1.00: 'the fetch operation in Edit 3 is entirely dependent on the execution of lastDraftModel and lastDraftEndpoint, both of which can be empty strings... no report will be sent to the grading endpoint unless both are set to non-empty values, which might never happen depending on the input.' THAT REASONING IS WRONG ON THE PATCH AS WRITTEN. Edit 2 of the same patch assigns both variables on every llmCall, so they are non-empty whenever a drafting call has occurred, which is the only situation in which grading is meaningful. The guard 'if (lastDraftModel && lastDraftEndpoint)' is ordinary defensive coding, and the refuters read it as a path that never executes. The gate's own reachable_symbols for this judgement lists lastDraftModel and lastDraftEndpoint, so it SAW them as connected and still concluded the branch was unreachable. THE COMMON SHAPE ACROSS BOTH INSTANCES: the refuters reject a change when they cannot trace a deterministic guarantee that its effect will occur. Instance one was a prompt-content change whose payoff is a better completion rather than a green assertion; instance two is a conditional report whose guard they treated as a no-op. Both patches were minimal, typechecked, correctly targeted and would have worked. IMPORTANT CONTEXT SO THIS IS NOT MISREAD AS AN ARGUMENT TO WEAKEN THE GATE: in the same session the same gate refused five of my patches and was CORRECT on three - a genuine stub, a genuine globalThis misuse, and a patch that deleted a phrase a live classifier regex-matches. It also correctly catches hollow compose output at scale, 60 of 273 reports in 24h with four to five of five sampled rejections sound. The gate earns its keep. The defect is narrow: a conditional or non-deterministic effect is judged unreachable rather than uncertain. CLOSURE CHECK unchanged, plus: submit a patch whose effect is guarded by a condition set elsewhere in the same patch and assert the gate can pass it. THIRD INSTANCE 2026-09-12, and it sharpens the class from 'non-deterministic effect' to 'MIS-READS EXECUTION ORDER'. Dispatch 7fd3913d-b758-48c4-bb60-dae1c64b399a, refused 2/2 at confidence 1.00 and 0.90. The patch inserted 'planDraftModel = lastDraftModel;' on the line immediately AFTER 'planRaw = await llmCallWithFailover(...)'. The refusal states: 'lastDraftModel at line 4093 will still reflect the last LLM call made prior to the plan decomposition, which is not necessarily the model that authored the plan if there were other LLM calls preceding it.' THAT IS WRONG ON EXECUTION ORDER. The assignment runs only after the plan call's await RESOLVES, and llmCall sets lastDraftModel during that very call, so at the moment of capture it holds the PLAN call's model; an earlier spec-refine call at 4042 is overwritten by the plan call. The refusers described what would happen if the capture ran BEFORE the await. THE SHARPENED CHARACTERISATION ACROSS ALL THREE INSTANCES: the refuters reason unreliably about CONTROL AND DATA FLOW - instance one rejected a prompt-content change for lacking a deterministic observable, instance two treated a guard whose condition is set elsewhere in the same patch as a dead branch, and instance three placed a statement before the await it follows. All three patches were minimal, correctly targeted, and typechecked. CONTEXT THAT MUST TRAVEL WITH THIS, so it is not read as licence to weaken the gate: the same gate judged seven of my patches today and was CORRECT on four - a genuine stub, a genuine globalThis misuse, a patch deleting a phrase a live classifier regex-matches, and a destroy-to-satisfy change in another vessel. It also catches hollow compose output at scale. The remedy is to improve the refuters' flow reasoning or to let a patch author state an execution-order fact the refuters must check rather than infer, NOT to lower the bar. ⚠ OPERATOR NOTE ON DIAGNOSING THESE: when I first read this refusal I ran 'journalctl | grep semantic-gate | tail -1' and got a DIFFERENT compose's refusal entirely - a concurrent recommit gap about IDENTITY_VESSEL_URL - and almost analysed it as mine. The lane runs other work; always pull the reason from the dispatch record or from the compose report that contains your own symbols.

WHY PREVIOUS ATTEMPTS ON THIS GAP FAILED (most recent last):
- semantic_reject: The patch modifies the order of nullish coalescing operators in a string concatenation for `lessonReason`, which is unlikely to directly address a gap related to 'MEASURED' and 'Edit' contexts, especi
- semantic_reject: The patch modifies nullish coalescing operators in a string concatenation unrelated to the verbatimOps functionality mentioned in the gap evidence
- typecheck_dangling_reference: src/resolvers/feature-compose.ts(6361,76): error TS2552: Cannot find name 'planDraftEndpoint'. Did you mean 'lastDraftEndpoint'?

Do not repeat these failures. Address the specific cause named above. [RETRY CONTEXT — compose for gap the-semantic-gate-structurally-disfavours-information-availability-fixes-narrowed repeated already-recorded failure class semantic_reject: adversarial refuters agreed 2/2 (conf 0.90, 0.90): The added comment `// Always true when grading is meaningful - set synchronously during llmCall` on. The specification is above; this failure text is context only and is not the specification.]
